uv_mapping: u = (x - X0) / ortho_scale + centring offset; see the runtime sampler. The render is square and the box is not, so both axes normalise by ortho_scale.
what_it_is: Sky visibility from ground level given the whole massing, rendered top-down with a white world and no sun. Not a light map and not a shadow map: it does not depend on sun position and stays valid at every hour.
